Use these native logical 390x748 positions and sizes:

The first version placed the top file card about 10px too low, the map cards were slightly short and vertically offset, and the audio/contact cards were 10–13px too high. Follow the native coordinates above; do not compress the overall 748px canvas.

Do not invent roads or add extra people, attachments, text, controls, wallpaper, shadows or texture.
